```{=html}
<script>
window.FP4_CONFIG = {
  stageId:      'fp4-stage',
  markerClass:  'fp4-slide',
  fragmentIds:  ['fp4-frag-geom', 'fp4-frag-labs', 'fp4-frag-theme'],
  geom:         'candlestick',
  overlay:      null,
  facet:        { tickers: ['AAPL', 'MSFT', 'SPY', 'TLT'], rows: 2, cols: 2 },
  layers:       ['geom', 'labs', 'theme'],
  xDomain:      [0, 119],
  xBreaks:      [0, 40, 80, 119],
  xMinor:       [20, 60, 100],
  yBreaks:      [],   // populated per-panel by niceTicks in facet mode
  yMinor:       [],
  colors:       ['#2A4E72', '#B94A48'],
  labs: {
    title: 'Ten years of monthly candles — four tickers',
    x:     '',
    y:     '',
    color: ''
  },
  legend:       false,
  codeHtml:
    '<span data-blk="base"><span class="gg-fn">ggplot</span>(prices,\n' +
    '       <span class="gg-fn">aes</span>(date, close, <span class="gg-arg">group</span> = symbol)) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="geom">  <span class="gg-fn">geom_candlestick</span>(\n' +
    '    <span class="gg-fn">aes</span>(<span class="gg-arg">open</span> = open, <span class="gg-arg">high</span> = high,\n' +
    '        <span class="gg-arg">low</span> = low, <span class="gg-arg">close</span> = close)) +\n' +
    '  <span class="gg-fn">facet_wrap</span>(~ symbol, <span class="gg-arg">ncol</span> = <span class="gg-num">2</span>,\n' +
    '             <span class="gg-arg">scales</span> = <span class="gg-str">"free_y"</span>) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="labs">  <span class="gg-fn">labs</span>(<span class="gg-arg">title</span> = <span class="gg-str">"Ten years"</span>,\n' +
    '       <span class="gg-arg">y</span> = <span class="gg-str">"USD"</span>) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="theme">  <span class="gg-fn">theme_tq</span>()</span>'
};
</script>
```
